_note: These are triage OUTPUTS (the schema soc-triage-tool's analyzeOffline() produces), not raw logs. They reuse soc-triage-tool's built-in sample alerts run through its own rule engine, so the AI SOC Copilot demo starts from a realistic, already-classified alert exactly as it would arrive from that tool.

alerts.summary: Brute-force SSH attack: 6 failed attempts against privileged account(s) (root, admin) from 185.220.101.45. Root targeting indicates automated attack with privilege-escalation intent.
alerts.recommended_action: Block 185.220.101.45 at the firewall immediately. Verify no "Accepted password" entries follow in auth.log. Enable fail2ban. Rotate credentials for targeted accounts.

alerts.summary: Malicious PowerShell on DESKTOP-A7K2P (user: CORP\jsmith). Script uses download cradle / in-memory execution (IEX/WebClient/EncodedCommand) — common loader technique for second-stage payloads.
alerts.recommended_action: Isolate DESKTOP-A7K2P. Decode full script block. Hunt for C2 IPs across environment. Check persistence (Run keys, scheduled tasks).

alerts.summary: Cobalt Strike beacon activity detected from internal host 10.0.0.22 to 198.51.100.45:443. Cobalt Strike is a commercial offensive framework widely used in targeted attacks and ransomware operations.
iocs: sig:ET MALWARE Possible Cobalt Strike Beacon Activity
alerts.recommended_action: Isolate 10.0.0.22 immediately. Capture memory. Block 198.51.100.45 at perimeter. Hunt all hosts communicating with 198.51.100.45. Escalate to IR.

alerts.summary: DNS exfiltration detected: Base64-encoded subdomains sent to exfil.evilsite.xyz. Stolen data is encoded into DNS query labels to bypass DLP controls. High subdomain entropy confirms anomalous usage.
alerts.recommended_action: Sinkhole the destination domain at DNS resolver. Identify source host (10.0.0.45). Decode subdomain labels to determine exfiltrated data. Hunt for the implant on the source.
